data.title: LHV Group results in August 2026
data.description: In August 2026, AS LHV Group witnessed its most substantial performance of the year. The group achieved a consolidated net profit of EUR 10.7 million in that month, marking a notable increase of EUR 2.1 million from the previous month. The return on equity attributable to shareholders stood at 16.2% in August. This growth in profit was propelled by the ongoing expansion in net interest income, effective cost management, and the robust quality of the loan portfolio. The subsidiaries also posted positive results, with AS LHV Pank recording a net profit of EUR 10.2 million, LHV Bank Ltd reaching EUR 0.3 million in profit, AS LHV Varahaldus earning EUR 0.3 million, and AS LHV Kindlustus also achieving EUR 0.3 million in net profit.

data.title: Sysco Announces Pricing of Common Stock Offering
data.description: On September 14, 2026, Sysco Corporation disclosed the pricing details of a public offering of 12,345,679 shares of its common stock under the ticker SYY on the NYSE. Each share was priced at $81.00 for the Offering, which is set to conclude on September 16, 2026, pending standard closing requirements.
